# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Cost-reduction opportunity (if `cost`/`latency`/`num_messages` is a declared objective,
      run `detect_loop_patterns.py --run-dir $R --tag $BEST --split val` — free, no extra
      eval — and check its `by_tool` map for a same-tool-called-N-times-in-a-row pattern. A
      hit names the exact tool + repeat count: propose a composite/bulk tool (capability
      `tools`), a bundled script entrypoint (`skills-package`), or upfront-batched
      instructions (`prompt`/`system-prompt`) that replace the N calls with one. No hit
      (or cost/latency not a declared objective): say so plainly, do not leave this blank):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — create airline capability from empty seed: 2 new read tools + 3 code guards/returns + policy contract
- Changes I made (1 line per edit):
  - tools.py `find_reservations` (NEW read tool) — cluster A (wrong-reservation targeting, tasks 17/22): list a user's reservations with route/date/flight filters so the agent matches the described trip instead of grabbing the first id.
  - policy.md "Identify the correct reservation first" (+worked example) — cluster A: imperative to resolve+confirm the id via find_reservations, never assume the first.
  - tools.py `get_price_quote` (NEW read tool) — cluster B (guessed/stale booking total, tasks 25/23): authoritative total from CURRENT prices before booking.
  - tools.py `book_reservation` enriched errors (code) — cluster B/E: "does not add up" now names total+breakdown+signed shortfall+resubmit instruction; payment-not-found lists available ids.
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation` flown/already-cancelled guard (code) — cluster D (task 37-t2): refuse cancel when any segment already flown (date<today or status flying/landed).
  - tools.py `update_reservation_flights` + `update_reservation_baggages` return payment_delta/amount_charged/amount_refunded (code) — cluster C (task 11 COMMUNICATE "5244"): surface the engine's exact amount.
  - policy.md: "Execute immediately after confirmation" + "Recover from a write error" + authoritative-pricing + quote-the-returned-amount rules — clusters E/B/C.
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - find_reservations/get_price_quote are ADDITIVE read tools (16 tools total, <20) — cannot change any existing passing call.
  - book_reservation error edit only changes text on an already-erroring call; passing bookings never hit the branch.
  - cancel guard VERIFIED to not fire on the legit cancels in passing trials 19-t1 (Z7GOZK future 05-28) and 23-t1 (K1NW8N future 05-26/28); fires on 37-t2 NQNU5R (05-13/14 flown).
  - update-tool return is a dict superset of the full reservation dump + delta fields; DB mutation is in place BEFORE the return, so DB grading unchanged; adds the value the COMMUNICATE check reads.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — iteration 1, empty LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP, empty rejected.jsonl/history.jsonl.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still not cracked: cluster E (narrate-without-action/bail-out) is addressed only by prose this iteration — the stall is the agent ending its turn, which no code guard can force. If it survives, next lever is a composite confirm->write tool (then remove the write primitives). Cluster A relies on the agent CHOOSING to call find_reservations; if 17/22 still fail, consider an in-body guard in the update/cancel tools that rejects a write whose supplied flights' route doesn't match the reservation's origin/destination.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Cost-reduction: cost/latency/num_messages not declared objectives here (reward basis is DB+COMMUNICATE); did not run detect_loop_patterns.
- Focus next iteration: read the RESULT; if cluster A/E unmoved, switch from read-tool+prose to in-body write guards / composite write tool.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.417 Δ=+0.100 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={11, 12, 19, 25, 37, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — no task that was passing under the parent regressed: this batch did not clear the gate's threshold, it did not do damage. So the lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign — re-measure with more trials in ONE evaluation, or make the effect bigger. Keep the edits that produced the `fixed` tasks above as your starting point; do not rewrite them on this round's numbers.
<!-- cand_0001: rejected val=0.417 Δ=+0.100 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — escalate cluster A to an unskippable return; re-ship cand_0001's safe deterministic edits with more POWER
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file/tool + cluster):
  - tools.py `get_user_details` enriched RETURN (dict + `reservations_detail` route/date/cabin/pax summaries) — cluster A (17/22): the always-called read now surfaces every reservation's route inline, so the agent can't operate on the first id blind. REPLACES cand_0001's skippable `find_reservations`.
  - policy.md "Identify the CORRECT reservation" rule + worked example — cluster A: match route/dates, map city→airport, never default to first id.
  - tools.py `get_price_quote` NEW read tool — cluster B (25/23): authoritative current-price total before booking.
  - tools.py `book_reservation` enriched "does not add up"/not-found/low-balance errors — cluster B/E: breakdown + signed shortfall + "resubmit summing to EXACTLY N, don't reuse stored prices" + available ids.
  - tools.py `update_reservation_flights`/`update_reservation_baggages` return `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded` (new `_with_payment_amounts` helper) — cluster C (11): surface the engine's exact amount.
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation` flown/already-cancelled in-body guard — cluster D (37-t2).
  - policy.md: execute-immediately-after-confirmation + recover-from-write-error + authoritative-pricing (incl. one-cert→split-into-one-pax-reservations) + quote-returned-amount rules — clusters E/B/C.
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - `get_user_details` return is a superset of the old `User` dump; DB grader reads the DB not the return, so no passing task regresses; it adds the route info that makes 17/22's correct target visible. This is the POWER increase the gate asked for over cand_0001's skippable tool.
  - `get_price_quote` additive read tool (15 tools <20); book error edit only changes text on an already-erroring call.
  - update-tool returns: DB mutation happens before the return → DB grading unchanged; adds the COMMUNICATE value (11 gold = 5244 = engine refund).
  - cancel guard VERIFIED to fire on 37-t2 NQNU5R (05-13/14 < 05-15) and stay silent on passing cancels 19 Z7GOZK (05-28) and 23 K1NW8N (05-26/28).
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 REJECTED (val 0.417, Δ+0.100, broke={}, fixed={}) — gate verdict: no damage, needs POWER/SIZE not redesign. I kept its cancel-guard, enriched book error, enriched update returns, and policy contract (all did no harm), and REPLACED its weakest edit — the skippable `find_reservations` read tool — with an unskippable enrichment of the always-called `get_user_details`, directly attacking the hard-0 cluster A that cand_0001 only addressed via a tool the model could ignore.
- Refuted hypotheses: a prose-only reminder for narrate-without-action is known-weak (tools SKILL marks it already-rejected across the field); I kept it only as a secondary lever, not the primary fix for any cluster.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: narrate-without-action (cluster E) has no code lever in tau2 (stall = ending the turn); task 23's 3-cert→3-reservation decomposition (prose-only this round). If E persists, next lever is a composite split-booking WRITE tool that issues the N one-passenger bookings in one call and removes the raw book primitive.
- Plateau signal: only 1 prior RESULT (reject, +0.100, no damage) — not a plateau; the lever switch this round is "make the biggest cluster's fix unskippable (code return) instead of an optional tool."
- Cost-reduction: cost/latency/num_messages not declared objectives (reward = DB+COMMUNICATE); did not run detect_loop_patterns.
- Focus next iteration: read the RESULT; if 17/22 still fail, the model is ignoring `reservations_detail` — escalate to a resolver that the write path requires. If E/23 persist, ship the composite split-booking tool.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.433 Δ=+0.117 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={11, 17, 19, 23, 25, 37, 40, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — no task that was passing under the parent regressed: this batch did not clear the gate's threshold, it did not do damage. So the lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign — re-measure with more trials in ONE evaluation, or make the effect bigger. Keep the edits that produced the `fixed` tasks above as your starting point; do not rewrite them on this round's numbers.
<!-- cand_0002: rejected val=0.433 Δ=+0.117 -->

## Iteration cand_0003 — add the ONE new deterministic WRITE guard (payment-method-count) cand_0002 lacked; keep all its proven-safe edits; raise per-task POWER without redesign
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file/tool + cluster):
  - tools.py `book_reservation` payment-method-count in-body GUARD (**NEW this round**) — cluster B (23/25/8): counts payment sources, limits {certificate:1, credit_card:1, gift_card:3}, raises an actionable "split into one reservation per passenger" instruction BEFORE the "does not add up" check. Enforces policy line 86 the engine ignores. Deterministic — fires every trial regardless of model compliance.
  - tools.py `cancel_reservation` already-flown/already-cancelled in-body guard — cluster D (37-t2) [KEPT from cand_0002].
  - tools.py `book_reservation` enriched "does not add up"/not-found/low-balance errors — cluster B/E [KEPT].
  - tools.py `get_price_quote` NEW read tool (authoritative current-price total) — cluster B [KEPT]; 15 tools total (<20).
  - tools.py `update_reservation_flights`/`update_reservation_baggages` return `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded` — cluster C (11) [KEPT].
  - tools.py `get_user_details` enriched RETURN (`reservations_detail` route/date/cabin/pax) — cluster A (17/22/8) [KEPT].
  - policy.md: identify-correct-reservation-by-route; execute-after-confirm / recover-from-error / finish-before-transfer; authoritative-pricing + one-cert→one-reservation-per-passenger split; quote-returned-amount + change-only-requested-segments — clusters A/E/B/C [KEPT].
- Per change, EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - payment-count guard: for task 23 it refuses the 3-certs-in-one-reservation write (23-t0's exact failure) and tells the agent to split one reservation per passenger — making the gold structure much more likely WITHOUT hardcoding the exact gift-card allocation. VERIFIED to ALLOW every gold per-reservation split, task 25 (1 gift+1 cc) and task 8 (1 cert), so no passing booking regresses. This is the POWER increase the gate asked for twice: a deterministic per-trial flip, not a prose nudge.
  - All KEPT edits carry cand_0002's safety proofs: get_user_details/update returns are supersets (DB hash grader reads the DB, not the return); get_price_quote + enriched errors are additive/text-only; cancel guard verified silent on passing cancels 19 (05-28) & 23 (05-26/28), firing on 37-t2 NQNU5R (05-13/14 < 05-15).
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 REJECTED (0.417, +0.100, broke={}, fixed={}) and cand_0002 REJECTED (0.433, +0.117, broke={}, fixed={}). BOTH improved the mean and did NO damage; every task stayed `unresolved` (< 2·SE) — gate verdict both times: "lever is POWER or SIZE, not a redesign." So I did NOT redesign: I kept cand_0002's full edit set verbatim (its diff.patch in ./prior_iterations/cand_0002/) and added the single new deterministic write guard neither candidate had. I did NOT drop any edit, because no RESULT showed any of them regressed a task.
- Refuted hypotheses: (1) a NEW optional read tool for cluster A (`find_reservations`, cand_0001) — a mid-tier model can simply never call it (cand_0001 reject); replaced in cand_0002 by the unskippable `get_user_details` enrichment, kept here. (2) prose-only reminders as a PRIMARY lever — both prior rejects show prose moves the mean sub-threshold; prose is retained only as a secondary lever where no code lever exists (cluster E = ending the turn).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: cluster E (narrate/transfer-without-action) — no code choke point in tau2 (the stall is the agent ending its turn); addressed only by the contract prose. Task 23's EXACT gift-card placement across the 3 split reservations — left to the model (the count guard forces the split structure but a literal allocation would overfit the held-out gate).
- Plateau signal: TWO consecutive rejects, both +Δ, both zero-damage, both all-unresolved — a classic "effect real but under the 2·SE bar with 3 trials" plateau. Lever switched this round: from "add/relocate information the model may or may not act on" to "add a deterministic in-body WRITE guard that flips the failing trial every time" (the payment-count guard), maximizing per-task effect size at fixed blast radius. If this is still rejected with no damage, the remaining levers for a future run are (a) a composite split-booking WRITE tool for cluster B (removing the raw primitive), and (b) more trials per task in one evaluation to resolve the real +Δ the gate keeps measuring.
- Cost-reduction opportunity: cost/latency/num_messages are NOT declared objectives for this capability (reward basis = DB-state + COMMUNICATE, averaged); did not run detect_loop_patterns.py — no cost objective to optimize.
- Focus next iteration: if rejected again with no damage, this is a measurement-power plateau, not an edit-quality problem — escalate to the composite split-booking write tool for cluster B and/or request more trials; do not keep re-nudging with prose.
